title: Healthcare claim lifecycle bundle
description: Authorization, clinical evidence, diagnostic evidence, and claim review in one governed package.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: WorkflowBundle
metadata:
  name: healthcare-claim-lifecycle
  title: Healthcare claim lifecycle bundle
  description: Authorization, clinical evidence, diagnostic evidence, and claim review in one governed package.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  workflowRef: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-cross-09
  ontology:
    ref: ladder://ontologies/builtin/healthcare
    mode: sliver
    selection:
      propertyRefs: [patient.patient_member_id, care_authorization.authorization_id, healthcare_claim.claim_number, diagnostic_result.test_results]
      relationshipIds: [receives, billed_as, governed_by, produces]
  forms:
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/healthcare/prior_auth, role: approval }
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/healthcare/eob_cms1500, role: completion }
  documents:
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/healthcare/clinical_note_soap, role: supporting }
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/healthcare/lab_report, role: supporting }
